name: Memory Tags
summary:
Memory Tags, a super fun game where you can immerse yourself in a loving community! Explore our map and traverse great distances with your arms! Unfortunately, you've got no legs to catch yourself if you fall...

Dress yourselves in our finest clothing options in our catalog and pick all by yourself! A wide variety to choose from, and only some will be your pick. It's your choice!

Make friends along the way with our multiplayer system!
